registry_items.description: The RF-3 interaction family: MatchingExercise, SortExercise, and CategorizeExercise. Matching uses identical fixed nodes on both sides, with connection points on opposite edges; its primary interaction lets the learner click anywhere on each node, while the SVG line still runs exactly between the two filled points and drag remains optional. Categorize physically moves and reflows cards across an Unassigned lane and category columns; Sort reorders a list. Every variant includes a non-dragging WCAG 2.5.7 path, pointer and keyboard support, controlled/uncontrolled values, text-and-icon results, feedback, empty states, and token-only styling.

registry_items.description: A bounded practice orchestrator for heterogeneous child interactions. Owns navigation, attempts, submit/review phases and completion summary without imposing a universal scoring model or exposing feedback before submission. Supports controlled and uncontrolled progress, partial item arrays, disabled state, localization and opaque response/result types.
registry_items.name: practice-set
registry_items.title: Practice Set / Question Set

registry_items.description: RF-7 lesson/skill ProgressIndicator and ProgressOverview. Every snapshot pairs its visual bar with visible percentage/pending text, semantic progressbar values and lesson/skill labels rather than relying on color. Missing values remain indeterminate for streaming consumers; lists support localization, descriptions and explicit empty states.
registry_items.name: progress-indicators
registry_items.title: Progress Indicators

registry_items.description: The QuizItem family (RF-4) sharing one Card shell and one set of interaction/accessibility norms: SingleChoiceQuiz, MultiSelectQuiz, TrueFalseQuiz, FillInTheBlankQuiz and ShortAnswerQuiz. Each supports controlled/uncontrolled answer state (onAnswer/onSubmit), an optional informative-feedback slot shown only after submission, and correct/incorrect states carried by icon + text, never color alone. The correct answer is never rendered to the DOM before submission for the auto-graded variants; short answer uses assisted self-assessment against a revealed model answer. Composed from @didact/ui's Card/Button/RadioGroup/Checkbox/Input/Label/Textarea/ToggleGroup -- see packages/core/src/components/quiz-item.tsx for the full rationale.
registry_items.name: quiz-item
registry_items.title: Quiz Item

registry_items.description: A constructed-retrieval session with the explicit cycle write from memory, compare with a model, self-rate and schedule. Scheduler, incoming review state and persistence are injected; the component never owns a backend. Includes controlled/uncontrolled responses, localization, partial streaming content and accessible rating controls.
registry_items.name: retrieval-practice-session
registry_items.title: Retrieval Practice Session

registry_items.description: RF-10 criterion-by-criterion self-assessment with accessible single-select performance levels. Supports controlled/uncontrolled selection maps, disabled criteria, localized functional fallbacks, partial streaming levels and explicit empty/pending states. Reports textual assessment progress but deliberately exposes no score, answer key, weighting, correctness, pass/fail result or automatic grading path.
registry_items.name: rubric
registry_items.title: Rubric / Self-assessment

registry_items.description: A domain-independent simulation shell with accessible parameters, play/pause/step controls, injected deterministic runtime, actions, observables and snapshots.
registry_items.name: simulation-lab
registry_items.title: Simulation Lab

registry_items.description: A presentational ordered sequence for protocols, procedures, and step-by-step flows (RF-8), with vertical and horizontal orientations. Status can be explicit per step or derived from currentStep; complete/current/upcoming is conveyed through marker shape, screen-reader text, and aria-current=step rather than color alone. Supports partial step arrays for streaming consumers and configurable status labels for localization. Styled only with @didact/theme token utilities; no animation or interactive state.
registry_items.name: timeline
registry_items.title: Timeline / Steps

registry_items.description: An accessible gap-match interaction with real inline sentence gaps. Bank options can be dragged directly into each gap or assigned through the same click and keyboard controls. Supports bounded or unlimited option reuse, two-way selection, undo, partial or human-reviewed results, streaming content and post-submit feedback.
registry_items.name: word-bank
registry_items.title: Word Bank / Gap Match
